metadata.title: Gather Relevant Information
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Collect relevant information from various sources (documentation, code patterns, specifications, SME input) using the team's configured guideline-based approach to support upcoming design, analysis, or implementation work.

output.description: Gathered information stored in memory organized by source type

prerequisites: Information needs identified (what to gather and why)
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: check guideline → identify sources → collect from docs → collect from code → validate → request missing (if needed) → store in memory
This step uses guideline-based pattern: teams configure their preferred method for gathering information
If no guideline exists, identify sources based on process context and collect manually
Organize gathered information by source type: documentation, codePatterns, specifications, additionalContext

read: process.md (for context on what information to gather)

tools: read_file - Read guideline file, documentation, code files
list_dir - Check if guideline file exists, explore directories
codebase_search - Find relevant code patterns and implementations
grep - Search for specific patterns or references
bestPractices: Always check for team guideline first before manual collection
Document all sources consulted for traceability
Be systematic - cover all identified source types
Summarize key findings rather than copying entire documents
Note any gaps or areas needing SME clarification
Keep memory concise - reference files rather than duplicating content

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Check for user guideline
substeps.description: Look for team's guideline file that defines how to gather relevant information
actions: Check if .user-processes/guidelines/planning/how-to-gather-relevant-information.md exists
Note whether guideline is available for use

substeps.name: Identify information sources
substeps.description: Determine what sources to collect from based on guideline or context
actions: If guideline exists: read and follow its instructions for identifying sources
If no guideline: identify sources based on process context
Common source types: project documentation, architecture decisions, existing code patterns, API specifications, requirements documents, SME knowledge
List specific files, directories, or people to consult

substeps.name: Collect from documentation sources
substeps.description: Gather relevant documentation, specs, and architecture decisions
actions: Read identified documentation files
Extract relevant sections and key points
Note references to other documents if needed
Summarize findings under gatheredInformation.documentation

substeps.name: Collect from codebase sources
substeps.description: Search for patterns, similar implementations, and conventions
actions: Use codebase_search to find relevant code patterns
Read identified code files for context
Note conventions, patterns, and approaches used
Summarize findings under gatheredInformation.codePatterns

substeps.name: Verify external service contracts
substeps.description: For each external API dependency, verify you have complete contract information
actions: List all external services the solution will interact with
For EACH external API, verify you have: endpoint URL/path, request contract, response contract, authentication method, error codes/responses
If any contract is missing: STOP and request from user (provide repo URL, add to workspace, or ask SME)
CRITICAL: Do NOT proceed with incomplete external service information - this causes design rework
Summarize findings under gatheredInformation.externalServiceContracts

substeps.name: Validate collected information
substeps.description: Ensure gathered information is sufficient for the intended purpose
actions: Review all gathered information against the original need
Check coverage: Are all required areas covered?
Verify external service contracts are complete (from substep 5)
Identify any gaps or missing context
Note questions that require SME input

substeps.name: Request missing information
substeps.description: If gaps exist, ask user for missing context
actions: Present specific questions for each gap identified
Format: 'Please provide [information type]: [explanation of what's needed and why]'
For external services: offer options - (1) provide contract docs, (2) add service repo to workspace, (3) SME clarification
Wait for user response
Update gathered information with answers
Re-validate until information is sufficient

substeps.name: Store in memory
substeps.description: Save gathered information organized by source type to memory.json
actions: Write gatheredInformation object to current step's informationProduced section
Organize by: sources (list with type), documentation, codePatterns, specifications, externalServiceContracts, additionalContext
Include source references for traceability
Document any assumptions or limitations noted

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Check guideline → Identify sources → Collect from docs → Collect from code → Verify external contracts → Validate → (conditional: request missing) → Store. Substep 7 is conditional - only if validation in substep 6 identifies gaps.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Process context and previous steps for what information to gather
fields: Information Produced: gatheredInformation object with sources, documentation, codePatterns, specifications, externalServiceContracts, additionalContext
Decisions Made: Source selection, what to include/exclude
Notes: Gaps identified, SME questions, assumptions made

sourceTypes.description: Project docs, READMEs, architecture decisions, design docs
Existing implementations, conventions, patterns in codebase
API specs, requirements docs, contracts, schemas
External API endpoints, request/response contracts, auth methods, error codes
Subject matter expert knowledge, clarifications, tribal knowledge
